triage.title: Technical Validation
triage.description: Please confirm that you have performed these basic tests. Often, the hardware only needs an adjustment.
triage.footer: You must check all items to continue.

gpu.power: Did you connect all the PCIe (8/6-pin) power cables?
gpu.port: Is the video cable connected to the GPU and not the motherboard?
gpu.drivers: Did you uninstall previous drivers using DDU (Display Driver Uninstaller)?
gpu.psu: Does your power supply meet the recommended wattage for this card?

cpu.socket: Did you confirm that your motherboard supports this chipset/generation?
cpu.pins: Did you check that there are no bent pins on the socket or processor?
cpu.bios: Did you update your motherboard's BIOS to the compatible version?
cpu.cooler: Is the heatsink properly installed and does it have fresh thermal paste?

ram.click: Did you hear the secure 'click' when inserting the modules?
ram.clean: Did you clean the RAM contacts with a white eraser?
ram.single: Did you test the modules one by one in different slots on the motherboard?
ram.xmp: Did you disable the XMP/DOCP profile in the BIOS to test stability?

mobo.standoffs: Did you install the metal standoffs in the case?
mobo.cpu_power: Did you connect the CPU power cable (8-pin) in the top left corner?
mobo.pins: Did you check that the socket doesn't have any bent or burned pins?
mobo.flashback: Did you try to update the BIOS using the Flashback button if available?

other.manual: Did you consult the manufacturer's manual for installation?
other.compat: Did you verify full compatibility with the rest of your components?
other.cables: Did you check that all data and power cables are properly connected?

reasons.label: Reason for report
reasons.not_working: The product is not working or displaying an image
reasons.wrong_item: I received a different product than the one ordered

form.descriptionHelpTitle: What to include in your description?
form.descriptionHelpDesc: Explain what tests you did (e.g. I tried other cables), what components your PC has and the exact behavior of the failure. The more detail you give, the faster Selene will solve the case.
form.descriptionPlaceholder: Write the details of the problem here...
form.helperText: Be as specific as possible to expedite the mediation.

evidence.title: Visual Evidence
evidence.subtitle: Upload clear photos of the problem (labels, physical damage, or on-screen errors).
evidence.videoDesc: Record a continuous video showing the box label and the product defect.

errors.videoUploadFailed: Video could not be uploaded. Please try again.

success.title: Report submitted
success.message: Selene has frozen the funds for the order. A mediator will review your case within 48 hours.
